$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$rg = "c:\Users\carys\AppData\Local\Programs\cursor\resources\app\node_modules\@vscode\ripgrep\bin\rg.exe"
$root = "C:\Users\carys\cts"
$outDir = "C:\Users\carys\.cursor\plans"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null

# HIGH + MEDIUM patterns only (skip LOW 1.10, 3.4, 4.6)
$patterns = @(
  @{ id='1.1'; name='Pointer-based std::sort / std::stable_sort'; sev='HIGH'; cat='sorting'; tier=1; regexes=@('std::(?:stable_)?sort\s*\(') },
  @{ id='1.2'; name='std::set / std::map with pointer key, default comparator'; sev='HIGH'; cat='container'; tier=1; regexes=@('std::(?:set|map|multiset|multimap)\s*<\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:]*\s*\*[\s>,]') },
  @{ id='1.3'; name='std::unordered_set / unordered_map with pointer key, default hash'; sev='HIGH'; cat='container'; tier=1; regexes=@('std::unordered_(?:set|map|multiset|multimap)\s*<\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:]*\s*\*[\s>,]') },
  @{ id='1.4'; name='Pointer-based hash functors'; sev='HIGH'; cat='hash'; tier=1; regexes=@('std::hash\s*<\s*(?:const\s+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:]*\s*\*\s*>', 'hash_combine\s*\([^,]+,\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*->') },
  @{ id='1.5'; name='Random ops without deterministic seed'; sev='HIGH'; cat='random'; tier=1; regexes=@('\bstd::random_shuffle\b', '\brand\s*\(', '\bsrand\s*\(', 'std::mt19937\s+\w+\s*;', 'std::mt19937\s+\w+\s*\(\s*\)\s*;', 'boost::(?:random::)?mt19937\s+\w+\s*;') },
  @{ id='1.6'; name='Time/PID-based RNG seeds'; sev='HIGH'; cat='random'; tier=1; regexes=@('srand\s*\(\s*(?:time\s*\(|getpid\s*\(|std::chrono|clock\s*\()', 'mt19937\s*\([^)]*(?:time\s*\(|getpid\s*\(|std::chrono|clock\s*\()', 'seed\s*\(\s*(?:time\s*\(|getpid\s*\(|std::chrono|clock\s*\()') },
  @{ id='1.7'; name='getFullName/getPathName as map key or hashed'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='naming'; tier=1; regexes=@('getFullName\s*\(\s*\)\s*\]', '\[\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*->getFullName\s*\(\s*\)', 'getPathName\s*\(\s*\)\s*\]', 'hash_combine\s*\([^,]+,\s*[^,]*getFullName', 'hash_combine\s*\([^,]+,\s*[^,]*getPathName', 'insert\s*\(\s*[^,)]*getFullName\s*\(') },
  @{ id='1.8'; name='std::priority_queue<T*> without custom comparator'; sev='HIGH'; cat='container'; tier=1; regexes=@('std::priority_queue\s*<\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:]*\s*\*\s*>', 'std::priority_queue\s*<\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:]*\s*\*\s*,[^,>]+>\s') },
  @{ id='1.9'; name='min/max_element on pointer vector'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='sorting'; tier=1; regexes=@('std::(?:min|max)_element\s*\(') },
  @{ id='1.11'; name='std::unique on pointer vector'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='sorting'; tier=1; regexes=@('std::unique\s*\(') },
  @{ id='1.12'; name='Filesystem iteration without sorting'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='filesystem'; tier=1; regexes=@('\breaddir\s*\(', 'std::filesystem::directory_iterator', 'std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator', 'boost::filesystem::directory_iterator') },
  @{ id='2.1'; name='Pointer arithmetic/reinterpret_cast as hash/key'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='hash'; tier=1; regexes=@('reinterpret_cast\s*<\s*(?:size_t|uintptr_t|uint64_t|long)\s*>', '\(\s*uintptr_t\s*\)') },
  @{ id='2.2'; name='boost flat_map/flat_set with pointer key'; sev='HIGH'; cat='container'; tier=1; regexes=@('boost::container::flat_(?:set|map|multiset|multimap)\s*<\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:]*\s*\*') },
  @{ id='3.1'; name='Parallel floating-point reduction'; sev='HIGH'; cat='parallel'; tier=2; regexes=@('tbb::parallel_reduce', '#pragma\s+omp\s+parallel[^\n]*reduction\s*\(\s*[+*-]\s*:', 'std::reduce\s*\(', 'std::transform_reduce\s*\(') },
  @{ id='3.2'; name='Multi-threaded shared container writes'; sev='HIGH'; cat='parallel'; tier=2; regexes=@('tbb::concurrent_vector', 'tbb::concurrent_unordered_', 'tbb::parallel_for', '#pragma\s+omp\s+parallel\s+for', 'std::async\s*\(') },
  @{ id='3.5'; name='Thread-count dependency in algorithm sizing'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='parallel'; tier=2; regexes=@('std::thread::hardware_concurrency\s*\(', 'omp_get_num_threads\s*\(', 'omp_get_max_threads\s*\(', 'tbb::this_task_arena::max_concurrency\s*\(') },
  @{ id='3.7'; name='Project wrapper containers with order-sensitive use'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='container'; tier=2; regexes=@('\b(?:dosUnorderedMap|dosUnorderedSet|dosHash|hyHash|hyHashI|nwcInsOrdMap)\s*<', '\b(?:hySet|hyMap|hySetI|hyMapI|ndmPtrSet|ndmPtrMap)\s*<\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:]*\s*\*') },
  @{ id='4.1'; name='Lazy dirty-bit recompute in const getter'; sev='HIGH'; cat='concurrency'; tier=2; regexes=@('mutable\s+bool\s+_\w*(?:Dirty|Valid|Computed)\b', 'mutable\s+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:<>]*\s+_\w*(?:[Cc]ache|BBox|Bbox|Points|Area|Shape|Reg|Union)\b') },
  @{ id='4.2'; name='Lazy first-touch materialization / inconsistent lock'; sev='HIGH'; cat='concurrency'; tier=2; regexes=@('if\s*\(\s*_\w+\s*\.\s*size\(\)\s*==\s*0\s*\)', 'mutable\s+std::(?:mutex|recursive_mutex|shared_mutex)\b|mutable\s+\w*[Mm]utex\b') },
  @{ id='4.3'; name='mutable non-atomic counter RMW on const path'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='concurrency'; tier=2; regexes=@('mutable\s+(?:unsigned|int|uint\w+|size_t|short|long|uint8_t|uint16_t|uint32_t)\s+_\w*(?:Depth|Count|Ref|Cnt|Refs|Level|Idx)\b') },
  @{ id='4.4'; name='concurrent_hash_map accessor check-then-act'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='concurrency'; tier=2; regexes=@('tbb::concurrent_(?:hash_map|unordered_map|unordered_set|vector)\b') },
  @{ id='4.5'; name='Condition-variable lost-wakeup shape'; sev='MEDIUM'; cat='concurrency'; tier=2; regexes=@('\.\s*wait\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\)\s*;', '\.\s*(?:notify_one|notify_all)\s*\(') }
)

$globs = @('-g','*.cc','-g','*.cpp','-g','*.C','-g','*.cxx','-g','*.h','-g','*.hh','-g','*.hpp')
$candidates = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$byPattern = @{}

foreach ($p in $patterns) {
  $hits = 0
  foreach ($re in $p.regexes) {
    $raw = & $rg --pcre2 -n --no-heading -g '!**/test/**' -g '!**/python/**' -g '!**/docs/**' @globs $re $root 2>$null
    if (-not $raw) { continue }
    foreach ($line in $raw) {
      if ($line -match '^(.*?):(\d+):(.*)$') {
        $file = $Matches[1]
        $ln = [int]$Matches[2]
        $text = $Matches[3]
        $rel = $file.Substring($root.Length).TrimStart('\','/')
        $candidates.Add([ordered]@{
          pattern_id = $p.id
          pattern_name = $p.name
          severity_default = $p.sev
          category = $p.cat
          tier = $p.tier
          file = $rel.Replace('\','/')
          line = $ln
          snippet = $text.Trim()
        }) | Out-Null
        $hits++
      }
    }
  }
  $byPattern[$p.id] = $hits
  Write-Host ("{0}: {1} hits" -f $p.id, $hits)
}

# Dedup by pattern+file+line
$seen = @{}
$deduped = @()
foreach ($c in $candidates) {
  $k = "{0}|{1}|{2}" -f $c.pattern_id, $c.file, $c.line
  if (-not $seen.ContainsKey($k)) { $seen[$k]=1; $deduped += $c }
}

$files = ($deduped | ForEach-Object { $_.file } | Sort-Object -Unique)
$result = [ordered]@{
  module_path = $root
  module_slug = 'cts'
  search_backend = 'rg'
  branch = 'local'
  min_severity = 'MEDIUM'
  patterns_evaluated = $patterns.Count
  candidate_count = $deduped.Count
  candidate_files = $files.Count
  hits_by_pattern = $byPattern
  candidates = $deduped
}
$outPath = Join-Path $outDir 'nd_cts_candidates.json'
($result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress) | Set-Content -Path $outPath -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "Wrote $outPath"
Write-Host "Total candidates: $($deduped.Count) across $($files.Count) files"
Write-Host "Top patterns:"; $byPattern.GetEnumerator() | Sort-Object Value -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 | ForEach-Object { "{0}={1}" -f $_.Key, $_.Value }

| Pattern | **1.1** (tie-break gap on distance key) |

    return a.getObj()->getId() < b.getObj()->getId();
